method: PADLOC/Infernal CM route (padlocdb.cm, 21 models; corpus calls)
input_requirement: nucleotide window; best hit per annotated intergenic region
prior_retron_knowledge: high: 21 CMs built by CMfinder on Mestre 2020 clade-grouped upstream windows; model = clade label
structural_evidence: single-sequence alignment to a covariance model (sequence + consensus structure); E-value
expected_failure_mode: misses lineages unlike the training clades; cannot report ncRNAs overlapping a CDS (all calls intergenic); boundary jitter per model; types without a model (XI, XII, VI, VII, VIII, X) uncovered

method: Existing integrated RT–ncRNA pairs (rt_ncrna_pairs_v1; tiers T1–T4)
input_requirement: CM call + RT anchor in one record
prior_retron_knowledge: inherits the CM route; tiers add architecture (same strand, upstream, no CDS between, ≤200 bp) and E ≤ 1e-5
expected_failure_mode: as CM route; T2/T3 exclude atypical architecture by construction

method: Canonical oriented ncRNA dataset (rt_ncrna_oriented_v1, 16,458 exact ncRNAs)
Operator's 977 validated boundary set (not located; closest h5ad sets)
input_requirement: ±200 nt context around a known ncRNA
prior_retron_knowledge: RT protein matched to Mestre 2020; ncRNA mostly an Infernal/padlocdb call (validated_ncrna True for 165 of 936)
expected_failure_mode: not independent truth for a CM-vs-de-novo question; context is ncRNA-centred (a de novo method would be seeded by the answer)

method: Rfam structured-ncRNA negatives (1,230; incl. Group-II intron)
expected_failure_mode: no RT anchor, so an RT-anchored comparative method cannot be applied; replaced in-method by CTRL_GII_HARD

method: SPIRE Arm A (07 verbatim: mLocARNA + R-scape; our window/grouping/boundary rules)
input_requirement: RT anchor; 300 nt 5′ of start codon; ≥5 homologous windows (our rule; SPIRE: ≤40, no minimum)
prior_retron_knowledge: grouping only (SPIRE: type-HMM lineage; ours: RT50 protein cluster). No ncRNA coordinates, CM or motif
structural_evidence: multiple-sequence covariation (R-scape GTp, phylogeny-aware null) on an alifold consensus of a structural alignment
boundary_output: none in SPIRE; ours: union of covariation-supported helices, projected per member
expected_failure_mode: low diversity → no power; global alignment of divergent 300 nt windows → poor columns; ncRNA parts inside the RT ORF or beyond 300 nt unreachable; SPIRE's obs/exp > 1.1 rejects sets where covariation merely matches power
independence_from_CM: high for evidence; shares the CMfinder-era paradigm (clade-grouped upstream windows)

method: Arm B-struct (CaCoFold on Arm A's alignment)
input_requirement: same sets and windows as A
structural_evidence: covariation-constrained CYK fold (all significant pairs forced; powered non-covarying pairs forbidden)
boundary_output: ours: union of CaCoFold helices with ≥1 covarying pair
expected_failure_mode: inherits alignment errors of mLocARNA; adds unsupported thermodynamic helices (excluded by the rule)

structural_evidence: as B-struct, on a structure-free alignment
expected_failure_mode: sequence alignment can misalign compensatory changes and lose covariation; conversely it cannot manufacture pairing
